announcements.headline: Senior Secured Bond Tap Issue
announcements.insight: Kistos Holdings raises capital via a senior secured bond tap. This follows recent acquisitions of Ringhorne licences and Block 3 & 4 decrees, suggesting funding for these assets.

announcements.headline: Acquisition of Ringhorne Production Licences
announcements.insight: Kistos Holdings acquires Ringhorne Production Licences, expanding its portfolio following the Block 3 & 4 Royal Decree. This material acquisition builds on recent FID and interim results.

announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: Interim results follow a July trading statement and precede expected Block 3 & 4 developments. Shareholders should monitor for operational updates linked to these recent milestones.

announcements.headline: Issuance of Royal Decree for Block 3 & 4
announcements.insight: The AGM results were announced in July. This filing follows that meeting.

announcements.headline: Trading Statement
announcements.insight: Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details regarding the Balder Next FID and any strategic implications following the AGM results.

announcements.headline: Results of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results. This follows the Balder Next FID announcement in June.

announcements.headline: Balder Next FID
announcements.insight: Kistos Holdings announces Balder Next FID. As the first filing on record, this marks a new development for shareholders to monitor.
